info.description: Admin panel plus Device API v1. The device folder pairs with a one-time code and then signs every request with its own HMAC secret; see docs/android-device-api.md.

item.name: Android v1 (Device)
item.description:
Device API v1, as implemented after Phase 10.

Run "1. Handshake (pair device)" first. Generate a pairing code for the
screen in the admin panel (Screens -> the screen -> Device pairing), put it
in the {{pairing_code}} variable, and send the handshake. Its test script
stores the returned bearer token and HMAC secret in collection variables.

Every other request is signed automatically by this folder's pre-request
script. Nonces are single-use, so re-sending a request is fine (a fresh
nonce is generated) but replaying a captured one is not.

A pairing code is single-use and expires after SCREENS_PAIRING_CODE_TTL.
A screen that is already paired returns 409 already_paired until an
administrator resets it.

//   METHOD / path / canonical query / timestamp / nonce / sha256(body)
